1986-87 ANNUAL GIVING RESULTS BEST EVER
Once again the alumni of Psi Upsilon,
some of the most generous and loyal in
the fraternity world, have set new highs
in giving. A record $152,073 in Annual
Giving contributions were received in
1986-87, representing 2,376 gifts. This
response is truly heartwarming, for it has
allowed the Fraternity to meet the always
escalating cost of providing comprehen
sive service to all its members, especially
to our undergraduate chapters.
The following record of statistics and
lists, which represents gifts received from
July 1, 1986 through June 30, 1987 (gifts
received subsequent to June 30 have been
credited to the 1987-88 program), serves
to honor the faithful and supportive
members of Psi Upsilon who, by their
generosity, have enabled the Fratemity
to continue on its distinguished course.
Last year a new concept of recognizing
the sum total of contributions which an
alumnus has made to the Annual Giving
program since its inception in 1964 was
initiated. Levels of support have been
named after some of our great Psi U songs
to acknowledge each alumnus' cumula
tive giving record to the Fraternity.
Names in bolder print represent lead
ership contributors (1986-87 gift of $50
or more), and years of consecutive giving
are shown in parentheses after the name
and class of donors.
